snippet.title: Escape from Violet Hold Cinematic Trailer | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
Vanessa VanCleef and her crew need your help breaking out of the Violet Hold! Join them as they craft up an ingenious plan and cause some mischief along the way.

📌 Pre-purchase the Violet Hold Mega Bundle: https://shop.battle.net/product/hearthstone-escape-from-violet-hold-mega-bundle
